title: What a third distinction can carry through parity growth
claim: The flip bit is invariant under every meet-once pointwise-live permutation. State when full pair and triple minima guarantee enough equations, or enough boundary information, to carry the marked table through one and later rounds.
standard_statement: Consider the cut space of a finite wired graph with simultaneous replacement of its exterior attachments. Which edge permutations preserving the minimum bond size on all pairs and triples and fixing each growing terminal incidence pointwise extend to a permutation preserving the next pair table?
prior_work: The marked meet-once and repeated-meeting counterexamples change successor pair entries. The established EXTEND-ROUND equation-span transport theorem carries every subsequent round. Common-circuit existence in binary matroids is classical background and uses the supplied matroid; it does not reconstruct it from these minima.
source_contribution: Double-flip interpretation, observed short equations and unique minimum-bond envelopes, plus the terminal-separation constraints on growing boundaries.

validation.status: V1 same-task checks plus cut and parity-space proofs, separate program referee pending.

completion_gate: A checked conditional theorem or counterexample; preserve unrestricted claim as open unless independently settled.
conclusion: Pair and triple readings recover every shortest bond at an individual distinction. All marked matches carry the later rounds when these bonds, uniquely minimizing pairs and live equations span the parity equations; a two-attachment theorem also gives persistence without recovering them. A reached meet-once example with 239 junctions and 643 distinctions preserves all three readings, changes an equation, and still carries every subsequent table.
evidence_class: Mathematical conditional reconstruction and transport theorems, with a reachable counterexample to full equation reconstruction.
unrestricted_open_question: Show that every invisible equation difference in arbitrary reached stages is irrelevant to successor pair minima, or produce a failing specified matching robust to every fresh naming.
